_meta.why: The chat assistant is a narrow copilot over the user's own data, not a general chatbot. Tools are the ONLY way chat touches data (§19.2): the LLM never sees raw full transaction history; tools return aggregates and top-k relevant records only.
_meta.what: The registry of callable 'skills' the L6 chat layer may invoke. Each tool maps a natural-language intent to a deterministic engine/query and returns a STRUCTURED result the LLM then verbalises (never computes).
_meta.result: Every numeric statement in a reply originates from a tool result here; the guardrail (../chat/guardrail.md) cross-checks and blocks any figure not traceable to one of these tools.
changelog: 2026-07-17 — Created from SRS v1.7 §19.2 tool registry.

behaviour_rules.CHT-001: Every numeric statement in a reply MUST originate from a tool result; the guardrail blocks fabricated figures.
behaviour_rules.CHT-002: Out-of-scope requests (stock tips, tax filing, legal) get a friendly refusal + what the assistant CAN do.
behaviour_rules.CHT-003: Suggested chips drive discovery; free text also supported.
behaviour_rules.CHT-004: Conversations stored locally, deletable, excluded from backup by default.
behaviour_rules.CHT-005: On-device model is the default engine; cloud assist lists exactly which structured fields are sent and logs every call.

_meta.write_policy: Chat NEVER writes directly. The only mutating tool is create_txn_draft / add_to_buylist, which produce a draft or a list entry the user must confirm.
